finalText:
Found it: `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` was rounding to 2 decimal places in USD after each coupon step, then rounding again after currency conversion. That double rounding only shows up once a percent coupon is stacked with a rate whose conversion nudges the pre-rounded cent across a boundary — which is why it looked random and mostly fine.

Example: GBP cart with `SAVE10PCT`, $9.99 × 2. Rounding at $17.98 before converting gives £14.02. Converting the unrounded $17.982 gives £14.03. One cent, only visible after conversion.

Fixed by rounding once, at the very end, in the order's own currency — matching the reference the tests were written against. All 40 pricing-matrix tests pass now (was 30/40).
